entities.name: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Muradi al-Hadrami
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abū Bakr Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Murādī al-Ḥaḍramī or el Mûradi Al Hadrami or al-shaykh al imâm Al Hadrami was an 11th-century North African Islamic theologian and jurist. He died in 1095.
